_comment: Inline policy for the ECS execution role (landvex-ecs-execution).
The execution role is what the ECS agent uses to START the task:
pull the image, read the secrets, create the log stream. It is NOT
the task role — the application itself needs no AWS permissions.
Scoped to exactly the five secrets the task definition names, not to
landvex/* — a wildcard grows silently, and the next secret someone
puts under that prefix is readable by this task without anyone
deciding that. A test holds this list against
deploy/aws/task-definition.json in both directions: a secret the
task needs but the policy omits makes the task fail to start with an
error that names the ARN and nothing else.
